issues.description: manifest.yaml uses 'software:' as the top-level identifier field instead of 'name:' as specified in code style rule 14. The rule template shows 'name: zlib' but this file uses 'software: autojump'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'software: autojump' to 'name: autojump' to match the code style rule 14 template, or update the rule to formally allow 'software' as an alias.

issues.description: build_system value 'custom' is not in the listed values (cmake | autotools | makefile | meson). While 'custom' is legitimate for a pure Python/bash script project like autojump, the code style rule does not list it as an allowed option.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding 'custom' to the allowed build_system values in code style rule 14, or document that 'custom' is acceptable for non-standard build systems.

issues.description: Date inconsistency within notes.md: '编译日期: 2026-06-01' (line 5) does not match '编译结束: 2026-08-05 04:01' (end of file) or manifest.yaml build_date '2026-08-05'. The metadata timestamp also indicates 2026-08-05.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the '编译日期' field in notes.md from '2026-06-01' to '2026-08-05' to match the actual build date and maintain consistency across all files.

issues.description: patch_description values (e.g., 'shebang python to python3') do not follow the example format from code style rule 12, which shows the description mirroring the filename with spaces (e.g., '0001 build aux config.guess'). The descriptions are more descriptive but omit the patch number prefix.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider formatting patch_description to include the patch number, e.g., '0001 shebang python to python3', or keep the current descriptive format if the project convention allows it.
